title: Global Accelerator
explanation: AWS Global Accelerator is a networking service that improves the availability and performance of applications by directing traffic through the AWS global network instead of the public internet. It provides static anycast IP addresses.
analogy: Global Accelerator is like an express highway on-ramp — instead of navigating through city streets (public internet), traffic enters the fast lane (AWS backbone) at the nearest on-ramp (edge location).
keyPoints: Provides two static anycast IP addresses for your application
Routes traffic through the AWS global network for improved performance
Supports instant failover between endpoints across Regions
Works with ALB, NLB, EC2, and Elastic IP endpoints

examKeywords.definition: A networking service providing static anycast IPs and routing traffic through the AWS global network for improved availability and performance.

commonMistakes: Confusing Global Accelerator (Layer 4, anycast IPs) with CloudFront (Layer 7, content caching)
Not understanding that Global Accelerator does not cache content — it optimizes the network path
